description: AI-DRAW a map layout: gpt-image-2 generates a top-down plan schematic (white walls on black) + a 3/4 greybox concept render, auto-traces the plan into MapPlan wall boxes, saves both to the Library. Reuse via gripforge_map_plan { item } or https://gripforge.ai/map-plan?item=lib_…&greybox=1. Alternative to the code presets when the layout should come from an image.

concept_path.description: With image_path: local concept/reference image stored alongside

convert.description: image_path is an ILLUSTRATED/textured top view: gpt-image-2 converts it into the binary wall diagram first (the original becomes the concept image)

extent_m.description: Playfield size in metres the image maps onto (default 110)

image_path.description: Trace THIS local image instead of generating one (hand-drawn plan, radar crop). White walls on black — or set invert for radar-style (bright walkable on dark)

invert.description: image_path is radar-style: walkable is bright, everything dark becomes wall

min_street_m.description: Guaranteed minimum street width in metres — narrower passages are carved wider (default 2.6)

plan_item.description: Existing traced plan: re-render its concept image, or with retrace=true re-trace it

prompt.description: e.g. "moroccan desert village bomb map, tight alleys, two plazas"

retrace.description: With plan_item: re-trace the stored plan image with the new threshold/extent (no image regen)

threshold.description: Luminance above which a pixel is wall (default 145 — higher = thinner walls, wider streets)

views.description: Also generate N street-level KEY-ANGLE views (main lane, plaza, chokepoint, site doors) conditioned on the aerial concept — linked to the plan, shown in the studio CONCEPT tab

name: gripforge_map_concept
